# AGENTS.md

Guidance for AI coding agents working in this repository.

## Changelog

**Do not edit `CHANGELOG.md` manually.** The changelog is generated and
maintained automatically by [semantic-release](https://github.com/semantic-release/semantic-release)
on every release. Changes should be described through conventional commit
messages (e.g. `feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`) — semantic-release will turn them
into the appropriate changelog entries and version bumps.
